latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editing With Effects Free.

- Edit and enhance video clips with visual effects and transitions, processed on cloud GPUs.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM (up to 500MB), with outputs in 1080p MP4.
- Automated setup: free token generation, session management, and status feedback.
- Integrated cloud pipeline for fast rendering (1-2 minutes per clip).
- User-friendly workflows for quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinements.
- Handles uploads, credits, state, and exports via clear API endpoints and error reporting.
